object.description: Attach a figure to DOC-1 through the Document Editor. Overwrite the figure file with a new picture from outside, as draw.io saves, and activate. Expected: no Changed on disk banner; the row is redrawn and no changed figure is left to report. Overwrite the figure and also change DOC-1's description from outside, then activate. Expected: the banner shows. With the banner already shown for a description change, save the figure again and activate. Expected: the banner still shows.
